title: Two side-dungeons in different holds (Sunken Howe in Fenmarch, the Forebarrow in the Fallows) reuse the exact same wight-guards-verse-stone-then-alcove-loot structure down to identical sentence templates ('Whoever was laid here went with what mattered to them, not what was owed to a king.'), which undercuts the sense that each hold has its own distinct grief.
where: Fenmarch / Sunken Howe — chamber; The Fallows / the Forebarrow — chamber
